meta.name: elevenlabs-music
meta.description: ElevenLabs AI music generation - create original music from text prompts via inference.sh CLI. Capabilities: text-to-music, custom duration up to 10 minutes, genre/mood/instrument control, royalty-free commercial use. Use for: background music, soundtracks, jingles, podcasts, video scores, game audio. Triggers: elevenlabs music, eleven labs music, ai music, generate music, music generation, compose music, ai composer, create song, soundtrack, background music, jingle, elevenlabs compose, music ai

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字描述生成原创音乐
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成免版税音乐用于创作项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate original music from text prompts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need royalty-free music for creative projects

howto.what: Claude 能根据文字描述生成原创音乐，支持控制时长（最长10分钟）、风格、情绪和乐器，生成的音乐可免版税商用。
howto.when: 当你提到“生成音乐”、“背景音乐”、“配乐”等关键词，或要求创作歌曲、音效时触发。

say.text: 生成一段30秒的电子舞曲，节奏快，合成器主奏。
创作一首2分钟的轻快爵士乐，萨克斯主奏。
say.note: 会生成指定时长的爵士乐。

say.text: 制作一个10秒的播客开场音效，科技感。
say.note: 会生成短促的播客片头。

howto.what_en: Claude can generate original music from text prompts, with control over duration (up to 10 minutes), genre, mood, and instruments. Music is royalty-free for commercial use.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'generate music', 'background music', 'soundtrack', or ask to create a song or jingle.

say_en.text: Generate a 30-second electronic dance track with fast tempo and synth lead.
Create a 2-minute smooth jazz piece with saxophone lead.
Make a 10-second podcast intro jingle with a tech vibe.
